correctness.rationale: Explicit universal line restriction and zero-variable elimination yield no nonzero-fiber lines; independent cited 112-line upper bound and 112 explicit central lines exhaust support. Invertible four-equation Jacobian makes the local fifth equation the only obstruction: lambda at 48, lambda squared with h prime nonzero at 64. The finite-family scheme is proper and supported on 112 points, hence finite; at lambda fourth power one, gradient/Hessian give exactly 16 A1 nodes. Python verifier reproduces line census and all 64 derivatives but finite-field enumeration alone is not used for the universal conclusion.

value.rationale: A complete relative line Hilbert/Fano scheme for the natural Dwork family supplies non-obvious scheme-theoretic deformation invariants, discriminates 48 first-order-obstructed from 64 uniquely first-order-liftable lines, and proves the sharp 112-to-zero specialization. The order-two obstruction is invisible to central line counts and matters for K3 degenerations and Hilbert-scheme geometry.
